notes.2.2: An account entry. sḫsf (perhaps 'check' or 'withholding') and wḫ (perhaps the wḫ-fetish or another cult object, with gold mentioned next) are uncertain; Wdn,t+ +Jhy, joined by the editor, may be a name or an offering title.

nodes.text: *Sḫsf* of 1 *wḫ*, taken out for Wedjenet-Ihy, in the presence of the lector priest Kaihotep.
